acceptance.given: A recorded replay result and its complete Current Snapshot are available, and a clean fresh checkout can be prepared.

oracle.expected: The replay run from the fresh checkout reproduces the recorded result with matching verdict and diagnostics.
forbidden: Replay requires the original checkout state.
A fresh checkout cannot reproduce the replay result.
oracle.observable: Replay output and comparison report show the fresh-checkout result equals the recorded result.

acceptance.then: The recorded replay result is reproducible from the fresh checkout.
acceptance.when: Run the replay validator from the fresh checkout using the recorded Current Snapshot and compare its result to the recorded replay.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the replay test that executes from a clean checkout and asserts equality with the recorded replay result.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Add or maintain deterministic fresh-checkout replay execution and comparison against the recorded result, preserving the original binding identity before replay.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Replay result and Current Snapshot schemas remain backward compatible; rollback restores prior replay comparison behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Unreproduced replay becomes a verified matching fresh-checkout replay result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Fresh-checkout replay completes and its verdict/diagnostics exactly match the recorded replay result; any changed binding identity is rejected.

acceptance.given: A Replay Result is marked successful and includes Probe execution data.

oracle.expected: The successful Replay Result contains an independently produced verification of the Probe, with provenance distinct from the Probe's own execution record.
forbidden: The Probe is not independently verified by the successful Replay Result.
oracle.observable: Replay evidence records a separate Probe verification assertion and its source/provenance.

acceptance.then: The Probe is independently verified by the successful Replay Result.
acceptance.when: During successful replay validation, evaluate the Replay Result's independent Probe verification and inspect its provenance.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the successful-replay semantic check that requires an independent Probe verification record and distinct provenance.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require successful replay evidence to independently verify the Probe and expose separate provenance for that verification.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Replay evidence schema remains compatible while adding/retaining independent Probe verification fields.

slice_hint.state_transition: Successful replay without independent Probe verification is rejected; successful replay with it is accepted.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Semantic gate finds an independent Probe verification with distinct provenance in every successful Replay Result.

acceptance.given: Rollback has completed for the applicable route transitions and the non-empty Consumer Manifest is available.

oracle.expected: Every Consumer Manifest entry has a recorded post-rollback observation of the Prior Behavior Baseline.
forbidden: Rollback completes without observing the Prior Behavior Baseline.
Any Consumer Manifest entry lacks a post-rollback baseline observation.
oracle.observable: The post-rollback evidence enumerates all Consumer Manifest entries and contains a baseline observation for each entry, with 100% coverage.

acceptance.then: The Prior Behavior Baseline has been observed after rollback for every Consumer Manifest entry.
acceptance.when: After rollback, enumerate the non-empty Consumer Manifest and validate baseline-observation coverage for each entry.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the rollback acceptance test that checks one-to-one baseline observations for all non-empty Consumer Manifest entries.

affected_subjects: Post-rollback Prior Behavior Baseline observation for non-empty Consumer Manifest entries
slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce complete post-rollback Prior Behavior Baseline observation coverage across every non-empty Consumer Manifest entry.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Existing rollback evidence remains readable; coverage validation is additive and deterministic.

slice_hint.state_transition: Rollback moves from baseline-observation due to fully evidenced for all Consumer entries, or fails closed on any gap.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Coverage count equals the non-empty Consumer Manifest count and each entry has a baseline observation tied to its identity.

acceptance.given: The applicable Consumers and the FR-10 enable/disable/behavioral-rollback/re-enable flow are defined.

oracle.expected: Each applicable Consumer has a recorded completed enable operation executed through a real repository call surface.
forbidden: Enable is performed only through a simulated, indirect, or nonexistent call surface.
oracle.observable: Call-surface instrumentation or execution evidence identifies a real callable and records completion for every applicable Consumer.

acceptance.then: Every applicable Consumer has completed enable through a real call surface.
acceptance.when: Execute the FR-10 flow and inspect call-surface evidence to verify that each Consumer's enable operation was dispatched and completed through a real callable.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the FR-10 consumer-flow test that asserts each applicable Consumer enable is recorded at a real callable boundary.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure FR-10 enable operations execute through and are evidenced by real call surfaces for every applicable Consumer.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Consumer manifest and route-transition evidence formats remain compatible; prior dispatch behavior is restorable.

slice_hint.state_transition: Each Consumer transitions from enable pending to enable completed with real-call evidence.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: All applicable Consumers have distinct real-call records for completed enable; any simulated or missing call surface fails validation.
